# OpenBiota project research catalog — build specifications v01.0 through v08.2

This single-file catalog records the research, datasets, methods, software, reference databases and supporting documents recovered from the OpenBiota build-specification history and associated research materials. Each entry explains its contribution to the project and identifies its main institutions, geographic attribution and primary links. It is a provenance catalog, not an audit confirming that every proposed method has been implemented in the running application.

**Coverage:** 1,033 publication records; 704 grouped supporting-resource records; 0 unresolved source records; 2,435 normalized source URLs (2,438 recorded URL variants). The audited corpus contains 30 source documents plus recovered conversation-link and author–year citation indexes. The source-URL audit at the end maps every extracted URL to its catalog entry and originating document.

**Scope of exhaustiveness:** all recoverable links and identifiable research citations in the audited corpus below are included. Earlier conversation turns that were omitted from the supplied history and could not be recovered cannot be certified as complete. This is not a claim to list every paper ever published on the subjects. Where the original citation was incomplete, additional bibliographic lookup was used to recover the work; new verification links do not imply that those links appeared in the original specification.

## Reading and reusing the catalog

- **Main institutions** means the principal first/last-author institutions, named resource developers, archive submitters or issuing organizations supported by the cited metadata. It is not an exhaustive author-affiliation or funder list. An archive host is not automatically the institution that conducted a study.
- **Country / geographic scope** is accompanied by a basis: `STUDY` = explicitly documented participant/sample/experiment location; `AFFILIATION` = location of principal author institutions, with study setting not independently established; `MAINTAINER` = location of the resource developer/issuing organization; `UNVERIFIED` = not established. Multinational work can list several countries. A publisher’s location is never used as the study location.
- **Contribution to OpenBiota** describes how the work informed proposed features, interpretation, evidence limits, validation or data acquisition. It does not turn an association into causation or an animal/in-vitro result into demonstrated human efficacy.
- Publication versions, corrections, retractions and related datasets may have separate records. They are not independent replications. Identical DOI/PMID/PMC aliases are consolidated when bibliographic identity is resolved.
- Institution names are normalized throughout. “Not established” is intentional where source metadata do not support an attribution; no institution or country has been guessed.
- For a webpage, use the table headers as field names, preserve record IDs and source IDs, and split semicolon-delimited institutions/countries into searchable arrays. Open external links with `target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"`. Keep the caveat/notice table linked to each record.

## Source corpus and version provenance

The supplied version sequence is authoritative for this catalog. Older artifacts used different numbering: an earlier v07 covered FMT matching, while the supplied v07 covers strain resolution. The corpus preserves both filename and topic rather than silently relabeling the documents. Repeated documents/links do not create duplicate publication records.

## Corrections, provenance notes and interpretation limits

Read these notes with the corresponding record. They preserve source errors, contradictions, publication-status changes and dataset-access limitations rather than silently presenting them as settled evidence.

| Record | Note |
| --- | --- |
| P0007 | Original DGGE/qPCR and metabolite evidence requires explicit assay transport to shotgun features. |
| P0024 | 345 Chinese participants in the main study; do not assume medication-independent features. |
| P0035 | Source spec identifies disagreement between the abstract and detailed follow-up results; retain as null or uncertain pending source-level adjudication. |
| P0074 | Breath metabolite exposure is not a direct measurement of intact allicin concentration in the colon. |
| P0077 | Review and hypothesis paper; do not represent it as a successful replicated human treatment trial. |
| P0082 | Main patient recruitment and lead institution in China. |
| P0084 | ADNI is a North American cohort. A published erratum exists: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jalz.2019.03.002 . Institutions selected from verified author affiliations. |
| P0116 | Public-data availability mismatch: article mentions shotgun material under PRJNA1449485; specification audit found 180 public amplicon runs, not verified isolate WGS. |
| P0118 | Specification context says garlic oil, but the verified abstract identifies ginger oil; correct this compound identity before reuse. |
| P0119 | Institutional affiliation requires verification from full paper; publisher location is not used. |
| P0119 | Maintaining institution or research affiliation not verified; no institution inferred from publication host. |
| P0119 | Reported IC50 notation requires clarification; qualitative experimental activity does not establish a reliable comparative potency ranking. |
| P0120 | Institutional affiliation requires verification from full paper; publisher location is not used. |
| P0120 | Maintaining institution or research affiliation not verified; no institution inferred from publication host. |

| P0130 | Correction record; link to the underlying article and do not count as an independent experiment. |
| P0131 | Correction record; link to the underlying article and do not count as an independent experiment. |

| P0148 | Study protocol; no completed efficacy outcomes are reported in this publication. |

| P0150 | Maintaining institution or research affiliation not verified; no institution inferred from publication host. |
| P0177 | Database-development location; global research is curated. |

| P0189 | Cases and controls came from different studies; source spec also records inconsistent sex counts and potentially questionable nonbacterial calls. |
| P0201 | The paper calls the study randomized but describes alternating inclusion; this predictable allocation is quasi-random rather than concealed random allocation. |
| P0202 | Institutional affiliation requires verification from full paper; publisher location is not used. |

| P0243 | Corrigendum; link to the underlying corrected study rather than count this as an independent experiment. |

| P0630 | Nutrient-dependent mouse alopecia is not equivalent to human autoimmune alopecia areata transmission. |

| P0662 | The historical RA event was not independently adjudicated from the original full text in the supplied audit; no individual transmission probability follows. |

## Institution-name normalization

The following encountered variants were standardized. Distinct universities, hospitals and research institutes remain distinct unless the source explicitly identifies a school/unit of the same parent institution.
